title_short: Ian Snyder (client, Vista Colina) · Next Chapter
headline: A father at Vista Colina says fatherhood became motherhood this year, and that CASS gave his family safety and six months to get ready for the next chapter.
story: Ian opens with his own surprising line: fatherhood became motherhood, cooking, cleaning, laundry. Then the fall, told fast: his wife got sick, he was laid off, they lived in the car.

Then who he is and what Vista Colina gave them: safety first, then six months to save and get ready for the next chapter. He ends on hope: the system works, people will help you, <q>human kindness isn't dead.</q>
One fix from Frame.io: his captions overlap his name super. The super sits above the captions; captions stay on.
